outcome: Apgar score < 4 at 5 min in second twin
Umbilical artery pH in second twin
Composite neonatal morbidity in second twin
cohort: 527 twin deliveries at ≥32 + 0 weeks of gestation where the first twin was delivered vaginally, at a university teaching hospital in Western Sweden between 2008 and 2014
finding: An association, but not necessarily a causality, was found between longer twin-to-twin delivery intervals and a composite outcome of metabolic acidosis, Apgar < 4 at 5 min, or peri/neonatal mortality in the second twin.
mod_finding: Longer twin-to-twin delivery intervals were associated with a higher combined vaginal-cesarean delivery rate.
